title: Remove latest-schema repair DDL from initSchema
description:
Remove the hand-maintained latest-schema DDL authority from initSchema after migration-first initialization is in place.

Problem:
The existing init path can run latest CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS logic after migration compatibility checks, which can mask incomplete migrations.

Acceptance criteria:
- initSchema delegates schema mutation to the migration runner.
- initSchema no longer contains or executes hand-maintained latest-schema CREATE TABLE/CREATE INDEX repair DDL.
- Safe invariant/bootstrap row insertion remains only where appropriate and is documented.
- Repeated init is idempotent without relying on broad CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS repair behavior.
close_reason: initSchema delegates to migration runner; latest-schema repair DDL + legacy TS chain removed. Landed in PR #318 (merged).
